lanes.name: asim-alert
lanes.selectKql: tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) == 'finding' and case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now()) > ago(2d)
lanes.transformKql:
source
| where tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) == 'finding' and case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now()) > ago(2d)
| extend _kind = tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type'])))
| where _kind == 'finding'
| extend _time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| where _time > ago(2d)
| extend _sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _rule = rule
| project
    TimeGenerated = _time,
    EventCount = iif(isnull(aggregation_count) or aggregation_count < 1, toint(1), toint(aggregation_count)),
    EventStartTime = case(isnotnull(aggregation_start), aggregation_start, _time),
    EventEndTime = case(isnotnull(aggregation_end), aggregation_end, _time),
    EventType = 'Alert',
    EventSubType = 'Threat',
    EventResult = 'Success',
    EventUid = tostring(['id']),
    EventOriginalUid = tostring(['id']),
    EventOriginalType = tostring(action),
    EventSeverity = case(_sev in ('critical', 'high'), 'High', _sev in ('medium', 'warn', 'warning'), 'Medium', _sev == 'low', 'Low', 'Informational'),
    EventOriginalSeverity = case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)),
    EventMessage = message,
    EventProduct = 'Abstract Security Analytics',
    EventVendor = 'Abstract Security',
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.1',
    DvcHostname = host_name,
    DvcIpAddr = host_ipv4,
    AlertId = tostring(['id']),
    AlertName = case(isnotempty(tostring(_rule.name)), tostring(_rule.name), message),
    AlertDescription = case(isnotempty(tostring(_rule.description)), tostring(_rule.description), message),
    AlertStatus = 'Active',
    DetectionMethod = 'Correlation',
    RuleName = tostring(_rule.name),
    Rule = tostring(_rule.id),
    AttackTactics = replace(@'[\[\]"]', '', tostring(threat.tactic_id)),

lanes.name: asim-dhcp
lanes.selectKql: tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert') and tostring(network.protocol) =~ 'dhcp' and tolower(tostring(action)) startswith 'dhcp' and case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now()) > ago(2d)
lanes.transformKql:
source
| where tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert') and tostring(network.protocol) =~ 'dhcp' and tolower(tostring(action)) startswith 'dhcp' and case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now()) > ago(2d)
| where tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert')
| where tostring(network.protocol) =~ 'dhcp' and tolower(tostring(action)) startswith 'dhcp'
| extend _time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| where _time > ago(2d)
| extend _action = tolower(tostring(action)), _raw = tostring(event.original)
| extend _text = case(isnotempty(message), message, extract(@'dhcpd\[\d+\]:\s+(.*)$', 1, _raw))
| extend _fail = _action == 'dhcpnak' or _text has 'no free leases'
| project
    TimeGenerated = _time,
    EventCount = iif(isnull(aggregation_count) or aggregation_count < 1, toint(1), toint(aggregation_count)),
    EventStartTime = _time,
    EventEndTime = _time,
    EventType = case(_action in ('dhcprelease', 'dhcpexpire'), 'Release', 'Assign'),
    EventResult = iif(_fail, 'Failure', 'Success'),
    EventSeverity = iif(_fail, 'Low', 'Informational'),
    EventOriginalType = tostring(action),
    EventMessage = _text,
    EventProduct = product,
    EventVendor = vendor,
    EventSchema = 'Dhcp',
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.1',
    DvcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, host_address),
    DvcHostname = host_name,
    SrcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(source_ipv4), source_ipv4, source_address),
    SrcMacAddr = tostring(source.mac),
    SrcHostname = extract(@' from [0-9a-fA-F:]{17} \(([^)]+)\)', 1, _text),
    DvcInterface = extract(@' via (\S+)', 1, _text),
    AdditionalFields = pack('AbstractEventId', tostring(['id']), 'AbstractDataset', tostring(data_stream.dataset))

source

| extend _category = tolower(tostring(event.category)), _action = tolower(tostring(action))

| extend _type = case(_action in ('createuser', 'user.lifecycle.create'), 'UserCreated', _action in ('deleteuser', 'user.lifecycle.delete.initiated'), 'UserDeleted', _action in ('addusertogroup', 'group.user_membership.add'), 'UserAddedToGroup', _action in ('removeuserfromgroup', 'group.user_membership.remove'), 'UserRemovedFromGroup', '')

    EventMessage = message,
    EventProduct = product,
    EventVendor = vendor,
    EventSchema = 'UserManagement',
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.1',
    ActorUsername = user_name,

    TargetUsername = iif(_isGroup, '', _object),

    GroupName = iif(_isGroup, _object, ''),
